To understand the mechanism behind overfitting, let's first consider what happens during model training. When we train a model, we provide it with a set of data, known as the training data. This data contains both the true underlying patterns and some random noise. The model's goal is to learn from this data to make predictions. However, if the model is too complex, it can start to learn not just the patterns, but also the noise present in the training data. This is the first step in overfitting.

Imagine a model that has many parameters, like a highly flexible curve that can twist and turn to fit every point in the training data. While this might sound beneficial, it can lead to the model fitting every little fluctuation in the data, including those random variations that don't represent any real trend. This leads us to the second step: the model becomes overly specialized to the training data.

As a result of this specialization, the model struggles to generalize when it encounters new, unseen data. This is where the performance drops. The model might predict the training data accurately, but when faced with new data, it fails to capture the true underlying patterns. Instead, it relies on the noise it learned during training, which doesn't apply to the new data. This decline in performance is the final consequence of overfitting. Thus, the mechanism of overfitting involves a complex model learning noise instead of general patterns, leading to poor predictions on new data.

export default function Animation({ progress }) {
  const visualSpec = {
    subject: "Mechanism Behind Overfitting",
    recognitionCues: [
      "training points scattered around a true trend",
      "smooth general pattern versus a highly flexible wiggly fit",
      "new unseen point showing a large prediction error"
    ],
    requiredParts: ["training data", "true pattern", "complex fit", "new unseen data", "prediction error"],
    relationships: [
      "training points contain pattern plus noise",
      "complex curve follows individual noisy points",
      "memorized noise produces error on new data"
    ],
    morphology: "coordinate plane with smooth and overfit curves",
    view: "scientific model-fit comparison on one coordinate plane",
    forbiddenShortcuts: ["generic icon", "unlabeled blob", "decorative geometry", "unrelated analogy object"]
  };

  const boardPlan = {
    composition: "single coordinate-plane mechanism diagram with causal annotations",
    readingPath: [
      "title",
      "training data points",
      "true underlying pattern",
      "complex curve memorizing noise",
      "unseen point and prediction error",
      "generalization takeaway"
    ],
    reservedRegions: [
      { name: "title", x: 54, y: 34, w: 620, h: 46 },
      { name: "subtitle", x: 56, y: 83, w: 470, h: 24 },
      { name: "plot", x: 170, y: 140, w: 700, h: 305 },
      { name: "yAxisLabel", x: 104, y: 250, w: 28, h: 100 },
      { name: "truePatternLabel", x: 435, y: 160, w: 145, h: 25 },
      { name: "newDataLabel", x: 690, y: 150, w: 190, h: 25 },
      { name: "trainingLabel", x: 205, y: 448, w: 135, h: 25 },
      { name: "xAxisLabel", x: 480, y: 452, w: 75, h: 25 },
      { name: "complexLabel", x: 595, y: 465, w: 300, h: 25 },
      { name: "predictionLabel", x: 755, y: 300, w: 178, h: 25 },
      { name: "conclusion", x: 690, y: 490, w: 190, h: 24 }
    ]
  };

  const tCurve = phase(progress, 0.43, 0.77);
  const tError = phase(progress, 0.76, 0.95);
  const visit = phase(progress, 0.52, 0.76);
  const tracerX = lerp(250, 720, visit);
  const tracerY = 354 - 0.19 * (tracerX - 250) + 21 * Math.sin((tracerX - 250) / 23);

  const font = "Chalkboard SE, Marker Felt, Bradley Hand, Comic Sans MS, Trebuchet MS, sans-serif";
  const points = [
    [250, 362], [330, 328], [410, 315], [500, 268],
    [585, 278], [665, 227], [735, 266], [810, 205]
  ];

  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 1000 560" width="100%" height="100%" role="img" aria-label="Diagram showing how a complex model overfits noisy training data">
      <defs>
        <marker id="arrowInk" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0,0 L9,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#1f2937" />
        </marker>
        <marker id="arrowRose" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="4" orient="auto">
          <path d="M0,0 L9,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#be185d" />
        </marker>
      </defs>

      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="560" fill="#fbfbf8" />
      <rect x="54" y="26" width="892" height="508" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#d1d5db" strokeWidth="2" />

      <text
        x="60" y="66" fill="#1f2937" fontFamily={font} fontSize="34" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="1" data-teach-kind="write" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="0"
      >
        Mechanism Behind Overfitting
      </text>

      <text
        x="60" y="98" fill="#475569" fontFamily={font} fontSize="20"
        data-teach-order="2" data-teach-kind="write" data-teach-weight="2" data-teach-sentence="1"
      >
        Training data = true pattern + noise
      </text>

      <g
        data-teach-order="3" data-teach-kind="diagram" data-teach-weight="2" data-teach-sentence="1"
      >
        <line x1="185" y1="430" x2="865" y2="430" stroke="#1f2937" strokeWidth="3" markerEnd="url(#arrowInk)" />
        <line x1="185" y1="430" x2="185" y2="145" stroke="#1f2937" strokeWidth="3" markerEnd="url(#arrowInk)" />
        <line x1="185" y1="350" x2="850" y2="350" stroke="#e5e7eb" strokeWidth="1.5" />
        <line x1="185" y1="270" x2="850" y2="270" stroke="#e5e7eb" strokeWidth="1.5" />
        <line x1="185" y1="190" x2="850" y2="190" stroke="#e5e7eb" strokeWidth="1.5" />
        <text x="482" y="468" fill="#475569" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18">input</text>
        <text x="126" y="325" fill="#475569" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18" transform="rotate(-90 126 325)">target</text>
      </g>

      <g
        data-teach-order="4" data-teach-kind="diagram" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="2"
      >
        {points.map((p, i) => {
          const s = lagged(progress, i, points.length, { lagRatio: 0.3 });
          return (
            <circle
              key={i}
              cx={p[0]} cy={p[1]} r="7"
              fill="#3b82f6" stroke="#1e3a8a" strokeWidth="2"
              transform={`translate(${p[0]} ${p[1]}) scale(${0.3 + 0.7 * s}) translate(${-p[0]} ${-p[1]})`}
            />
          );
        })}
      </g>

      <text
        x="208" y="462" fill="#1e3a8a" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="5" data-teach-kind="label" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="2"
      >
        training data
      </text>

      <g
        data-teach-order="6" data-teach-kind="diagram" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="3"
      >
        <path
          d="M220 380 C330 345, 390 320, 480 286 S650 237, 830 190"
          fill="none" stroke="#14b8a6" strokeWidth="6" strokeLinecap="round"
        />
      </g>

      <g
        data-teach-order="7" data-teach-kind="annotate" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="3"
      >
        <path d="M502 192 C510 215, 518 241, 530 265" fill="none" stroke="#14b8a6" strokeWidth="2.5" markerEnd="url(#arrowInk)" />
        <circle cx="530" cy="265" r="4" fill="#14b8a6" />
      </g>
      <text
        x="435" y="181" fill="#0f766e" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="8" data-teach-kind="label" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="3"
      >
        true pattern
      </text>

      <g
        data-teach-order="9" data-teach-kind="diagram" data-teach-weight="4" data-teach-sentence="6"
      >
        <path
          d="M220 385
             C238 350, 245 386, 250 362
             S308 350, 330 328
             S375 345, 410 315
             S468 300, 500 268
             S550 310, 585 278
             S625 245, 665 227
             S705 315, 735 266
             S780 230, 810 205"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#be185d"
          strokeWidth="5"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          strokeDasharray="900"
          strokeDashoffset={900 * (1 - tCurve)}
        />
        <circle cx={tracerX} cy={tracerY} r={7 + 3 * thereAndBack(phase(progress, 0.58, 0.72))} fill="#be185d" stroke="#ffffff" strokeWidth="3" />
      </g>

      <g
        data-teach-order="10" data-teach-kind="arrow" data-teach-weight="2" data-teach-sentence="7"
      >
        <path d="M682 449 C676 414, 687 350, 704 289" fill="none" stroke="#be185d" strokeWidth="2.5" markerEnd="url(#arrowRose)" />
        <circle cx="704" cy="289" r="4" fill="#be185d" />
      </g>
      <text
        x="595" y="483" fill="#9d174d" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="11" data-teach-kind="label" data-teach-weight="2" data-teach-sentence="7"
      >
        complex fit follows noise
      </text>

      <g
        data-teach-order="12" data-teach-kind="diagram" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="9"
      >
        <circle cx="735" cy="218" r="8" fill="#65a30d" stroke="#365314" strokeWidth="2.5" />
        <circle cx="735" cy="286" r="7" fill="#be185d" stroke="#881337" strokeWidth="2" />
        <line
          x1="735" y1="282" x2="735" y2={282 - 60 * tError}
          stroke="#be185d" strokeWidth="3"
          markerEnd="url(#arrowRose)"
        />
      </g>

      <g
        data-teach-order="13" data-teach-kind="arrow" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="9"
      >
        <path d="M765 181 C754 190, 745 201, 738 211" fill="none" stroke="#65a30d" strokeWidth="2.5" markerEnd="url(#arrowInk)" />
      </g>
      <text
        x="690" y="170" fill="#3f6212" fontFamily={font} fontSize="18" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="14" data-teach-kind="label" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="9"
      >
        new, unseen data
      </text>

      <text
        x="755" y="313" fill="#9d174d" fontFamily={font} fontSize="17"
        data-teach-order="15" data-teach-kind="label" data-teach-weight="1" data-teach-sentence="10"
      >
        model prediction
      </text>

      <g
        data-teach-order="16" data-teach-kind="annotate" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="14"
      >
        <path d="M738 430 C760 447, 781 455, 808 465" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="3" markerEnd="url(#arrowInk)" />
        <circle cx="735" cy="218" r={12 + 4 * thereAndBackWithPause(phase(progress, 0.88, 1))} fill="none" stroke="#d97706" strokeWidth="3" />
      </g>
      <text
        x="690" y="510" fill="#b45309" fontFamily={font} fontSize="19" fontWeight="700"
        data-teach-order="17" data-teach-kind="write" data-teach-weight="3" data-teach-sentence="14"
      >
        fails on new data
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}
